title: Intelligence Brief
headline: Anthropic reports average daily merges rose from about 2,500 in May to over 30,000 in September
subtitle: Anthropic reports average daily merges rose from, Google says Android users can create a personal, morluto/rea led GitHub Trending at 54,679 stars

heroStat.label: Anthropic-reported rise in daily merges, May to September

insights.text: Anthropic reports average daily merges rose from about 2,500 in May to over 30,000 in September. Its seven-person team built Scion, a server-centric source-control system, and related systems in five months; performance claims remain company-reported.

Google says Android users can create a personal app in Google AI Studio and launch it on their device through Google Play without a developer account or public catalog listing. Rollout starts in select markets, including the US, for users 18+; adoption is not yet reported.

morluto/rea led GitHub Trending at 54,679 stars today. A separate GitHub API read at 05:36:56Z returned 216,031 stars, 53,297 forks, and 596 open issues; this confirms the snapshot counters, not reverse-engineering accuracy or long-term adoption.
insights.source: GitHub Trending and GitHub repository API

insights.text: Vercel's skills CLI installs Agent Skills across coding agents. Matt Pocock's similarly named repository supplies skill content and documents installation through that CLI, making them complementary installer and content layers rather than competing products.
insights.source: Vercel skills README and Matt Pocock skills README

insights.text: Liquid AI describes LFM2.5-24B-A2B as a local-agent model with 24B total and 2B active parameters, reporting a 131K context window and results across 16 benchmarks. Those are vendor-reported evaluations; the post also describes reward-hacking observed during teacher specialization.
NVIDIA's Personal AI Router routes independent local-inference requests across compatible computers on one network; it does not pool GPU memory or shard a model across machines.

Stacklok Mecatl is a provider-agnostic agent harness with permissions, hooks, delegation, durable sessions, and local-to-Kubernetes runtime options. Its README warns the default unauthenticated loopback setup and audit features are not a tenant-isolation boundary.
The scrape captured 12 successful sources and recorded failures for Reddit r/LocalLLaMA and r/programming. Neither failed feed is evidence of no activity, and neither is cited in this brief.
